method: Primary documentation webpages only; no data API, account, AWS resource, training or paid-service calls. No source price copied into fixtures.

records.title: DynamoDB transaction API
records.claim: Up to 100 actions, 4 MB aggregate, 400 KB per item; 10 minute token validity; no duplicate item targets within one transaction.
records.MP_implication: Budget all metadata/audit/outbox; durable operation receipts and staged visibility for large imports; no short-token lifetime idempotency claim.
records.distinction: Source fact constrains design; proposed MP defaults need owner agreement.

records.title: DynamoDB read consistency
records.claim: Tables support strongly consistent reads; GSI and Streams reads are eventually consistent.
records.MP_implication: Strong head/manifest base joins establish completeness; eventual discovery may lag without exposing a partial ledger.
records.distinction: Source fact constrains design; proposed MP defaults need owner agreement.

records.title: S3 event notifications
records.claim: Notifications are designed for at least once delivery.
